title: Decision Records
description: Decision Records is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Records every governance decision with its full context. Decisions store the question, options, votes, and outcome in one record. It takes decision events and produces records. Tunable parameters: per decision. Guarantee: no decision is ever recorded without its options.

fields.mechanism: Decisions store the question, options, votes, and outcome in one record.
fields.guarantees: no decision is ever recorded without its options

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Plain-Language Reasons
description: Plain-Language Reasons is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Writes the reason for each decision in plain words. The reason field is required and reviewed for jargon before the record seals. It takes decisions and produces reasons. Tunable parameters: required. Guarantee: records never seal without a reason.

fields.mechanism: The reason field is required and reviewed for jargon before the record seals.
fields.guarantees: records never seal without a reason

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Policy Linking
description: Policy Linking is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Links each decision to the exact policy clauses it applied. Clauses are cited by id; the link is verified against the policy version in force. It takes decisions, policies and produces links. Tunable parameters: by clause id. Guarantee: links always point to the version in force.

fields.mechanism: Clauses are cited by id; the link is verified against the policy version in force.
fields.guarantees: links always point to the version in force

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Vote Transparency
description: Vote Transparency is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Publishes who voted how on every decision. Votes are public by default with abstentions and recusals marked. It takes votes and produces tally. Tunable parameters: public. Guarantee: tallies always sum to the voter roll.

fields.mechanism: Votes are public by default with abstentions and recusals marked.
fields.guarantees: tallies always sum to the voter roll

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Change Diffing
description: Change Diffing is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Shows exactly what changed when a policy is amended. Amendments render as a word-level diff with the author and rationale. It takes amendments and produces diffs. Tunable parameters: word-level. Guarantee: diffs never hide deletions.

fields.mechanism: Amendments render as a word-level diff with the author and rationale.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Appeal Trails
description: Appeal Trails is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Keeps the full trail when a decision is appealed. Appeals append to the original record; the whole history stays in one place. It takes appeals and produces trails. Tunable parameters: append-only. Guarantee: appeals never fork the record.

fields.mechanism: Appeals append to the original record; the whole history stays in one place.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Retention Rules
description: Retention Rules is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Applies retention rules so logs live exactly as long as required. Each record type has a retention period; expiry archives, never deletes silently. It takes record types and produces retention. Tunable parameters: per type. Guarantee: expiry always archives first.

fields.mechanism: Each record type has a retention period; expiry archives, never deletes silently.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Redaction Support
description: Redaction Support is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Redacts sensitive passages while keeping the record verifiable. Redactions replace text with a hash so presence is provable without content. It takes sensitive text and produces redacted record. Tunable parameters: hash-kept. Guarantee: redactions never break the chain.

fields.mechanism: Redactions replace text with a hash so presence is provable without content.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Searchable Archive
description: Searchable Archive is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Makes every governance record searchable by text and tag. Records are indexed on write; queries return ranked hits with context. It takes records and produces search. Tunable parameters: full-text. Guarantee: indexing never lags more than a minute.

fields.mechanism: Records are indexed on write; queries return ranked hits with context.
fields.guarantees: indexing never lags more than a minute

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Public Summaries
description: Public Summaries is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Publishes a public summary of non-confidential decisions. Summaries are auto-drafted from the record and approved before publishing. It takes records and produces summaries. Tunable parameters: approved. Guarantee: confidential items never leak into summaries.

fields.mechanism: Summaries are auto-drafted from the record and approved before publishing.
fields.guarantees: confidential items never leak into summaries

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Meeting Minutes
description: Meeting Minutes is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Turns meeting transcripts into structured minutes. Decisions, action items, and owners are extracted and linked to the log. It takes transcripts and produces minutes. Tunable parameters: per meeting. Guarantee: minutes always link to decision records.

fields.mechanism: Decisions, action items, and owners are extracted and linked to the log.
fields.guarantees: minutes always link to decision records

title: Conflict Declarations
description: Conflict Declarations is a governance ability in the Self-Documenting Governance Logs database. Records conflicts of interest declared before votes.
